manualPoseWindows.description: Both wrists at kettlebell handles near knees/shins and well below shoulders throughout. Torso is bent forward; this is a wrist-down pose window, not a claim of ideal upright camera calibration.
Both anatomical wrists clearly above their shoulders throughout. Two kettlebells, raised wrists, shoulders and feet remain in frame; one visible person. Neither opposite wrist is down.

wholeSelectionReview.observedMotion: Both wrists begin down, rise together to rack/chest height, then press overhead together. No held single-up/opposite-down action observed anywhere in this crop.
wholeSelectionReview.scope: Negative under the one-up/opposite-down policy only; does not certify a six-gesture goal or positive anatomical left raise.
wholeSelectionReview.onsetUncertainty: Exact shoulder crossing and both-up onset are intentionally not annotated; only the conservative interior windows are certified. No event emission window applies to the expected empty sequence.
qualityLimits: Initial neutral has a bent torso and moving kettlebells.
The crop ends during both-up, so no return-down interval is claimed.
Source is played with unchanged timestamp cadence; original recording speed beyond the published file is not independently known.
